tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the Edip Saat catalogue for watches by keyword, brand or model name. Returns matching products and brand pages.

searchTerm.description: The search keyword: a product name, brand or model, e.g. "Tissot" or "otomatik erkek saati".

tools.name: subscribe_newsletter
tools.description: Fill in the Edip Saat newsletter subscription field with an e-mail address. Does not subscribe on its own — the visitor still has to confirm by pressing the subscribe button.

email.description: The e-mail address to subscribe to the newsletter.
